data.one_liner: A Flutter UI kit with Apple Liquid Glass aesthetics and Telegram-inspired fluid UI components.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of glassmorphic UI components including blur cards, sliding tabs, app bars, buttons, dialogs, and bottom sheets. Features smart platform adaptation for hardware-accelerated backdrop filters on iOS and smooth alpha transparency fallbacks on Android.
use_when: You want to build an application with modern glassmorphism and liquid glass aesthetics.
You need pre-built Telegram-style fluid UI elements like sliding tabs, frosted app bars, and translucent cards.
You want theme-driven glass components that adapt across Android, iOS, web, and desktop.
avoid_when: Your project strictly adheres to native Material Design or Cupertino guidelines without custom translucency effects.
You are looking for a state management library or backend client.
strengths: Rich collection of specialized glassmorphic widgets and layout wrappers.
Smart platform adaptation for optimal rendering performance across devices.
Built-in design token system via ThemeData extensions.
weaknesses: Strongly opinionated visual style may not fit all application designs.
Relies on external platform-specific rendering behaviors for blur effects.
data.setup_notes: Add frosted_ui_kit to pubspec.yaml and configure optional ThemeData extensions for global styling.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer traditional Material Design components over custom glassmorphic aesthetics.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want native iOS-styled components instead of a cross-platform frosted UI kit.
